scenes.title: The regular
scenes.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: one portrait 9:16 first-person gameplay cutaway concept for VIGINTI.
Input reference: use the supplied image for the ESTABLISHED cabinet, palette, materials and room identity, not its fixed camera composition. The cabinet design is SETTLED: worn red/cream shell, petrol-blue display, amber controls, three horizontal recessed player wells with a maximum of FIVE cards each, blank-centered cards with corner indices only, relics and challenges flanking dealer. If a piece of the screen appears, preserve that arrangement; no vertical hands, extra UI, giant central suits or new cabinet design. This shot explores the CHARACTER MOMENT beside it, not the layout.

World: late-night casino lounge aboard a long-haul interstellar passenger ferry. Faded ambition, functional luxury, scuffed brass, red vinyl seats, amber cage lamps, exposed utility details, a dark blue observation window. Various adult robot passengers and staff, no humans. Warm, lived-in and funny, not a haunted casino or dystopian prison. The humor comes from familiar behavior and tired social interactions, not cute cartoon robots or sleazy sexual comedy.
Player: seated adult gruff robot traveler seen ONLY THROUGH HIS OWN EYES. Battered dark steel articulated hands, brass-colored knuckle rivets, worn navy work-jacket cuffs, one faded red service cuff. NEVER an external third-person shot of the player; no human fingers or skin. Camera eye position stays anchored to the same stool and turns/tilts naturally rather than teleporting. Body can appear when explicitly looking down. All meshes, hands and cabinet share coherent 3D perspective.
Style: chunky slightly retro in-engine 3D, visible modest polygon facets, coarse painted texture texels, limited material complexity, restrained bloom, subtle dither. NOT glossy photorealistic cinematic rendering; no shallow photographic bokeh obscuring everything. Bold readable silhouettes, dark blue/cream/rust with warm amber light. Maintain consistent character and room design across the set. No HUD, dialogue bubbles, subtitles, captions, watermarks or contact-sheet panels. One complete scene.
SCENE: The player's head has turned RIGHT about 45 degrees toward a waitress who has stopped at his stool. The cabinet remains a cropped sliver along LEFT edge, visibly the same red/cream one, not dominating. Main focus is the competent, slightly tired ROBOT WAITRESS at seated-player eye level, seen waist-up to just above her head, with some room around her. She has a chunky cream-painted mechanical faceplate, amber lens eyes with expressive mechanical eyelids, a few repair seams, short metal head casing, burgundy utility vest over a cream shirt and a practical apron. Friendly deadpan expression; not a glamorous android model, not a pinup, no cleavage or sexualized proportions.
She holds a small round tray with a short amber drink and a folded paper napkin; her free hand rests on the back of an empty nearby stool. Player's right metal hand reaches halfway toward the glass at the bottom. The service interaction feels familiar, dry, slightly awkward: she knows how long he has been sitting here. Background hints at tired robot patrons and ferry windows. Cabinet visible enough to orient us but waitress is clearly the subject. First-person only.
